subject: Evaluation playbook & volume ladder — plan and timeline
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@omniflow.ai>, Carlos Ruiz <carlos@omniflow.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation playbook & volume ladder — plan and timeline

Hi Elena / Carlos,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great product and clear fit for the content-moderation pipeline you described. Per our conversation, I put together a lightweight evaluation playbook and an initial volume ladder so we can drive toward a scoped production commit if/when the eval shows signal.

Attachments: MAP-OmniFlow-v1.pdf (draft MAP with milestones), usage-projection-OmniFlow.csv (rough token estimates).

High-level proposal:
- Week 0–2: sandbox + integration (sample data, ingestion tests)
- Week 3–6: focused eval (throughput + quality checks against your eval set) — target 50M tokens/month during eval
- Month 3–6: staged ramp if eval passes (month 3 -> 150M, month 4 -> 300M, month 6 -> goal 600M tokens/month)

Pricing and commercial asks I want to surface early (so we can confirm with legal/finance):
- Committed monthly token tiers with step discounts at 300M and 600M TPM-equivalent
- Evaluation credits during the first 6 weeks, then transition pricing on a monthly SMP commit

Can you confirm the quality gates you need during the focused eval (latency, accuracy thresholds), and whether the ramp velocity above looks feasible from your side? If you prefer, Marissa can run through the MAP and term sheet with procurement.

Best,
Logan

--
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0139
From: Elena Park <elena@omniflow.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <carlos@omniflow.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation playbook & volume ladder — plan and timeline

Thanks Logan — this is helpful and matches our internal view. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Eval gates:
- Latency: 95th perc < 180ms for typical 512-token requests
- Quality: match or exceed our baseline classifier F1 by +3 pts on the holdout set
- Stability: no more than 1% error rate on retries over a 1-week window

2) Volume ask: We can do the focused eval at 50M tokens/month as proposed. For ramp, can we rework the target to: month 3 -> 200M, month 4 -> 400M, month 6 -> 800M? Our product roadmap expects heavier usage in month 5.

3) Pricing: procurement will want clear breakpoints. Can you share what discount tiers you normally offer at 300M and 600M thresholds? Also, is there flexibility on a time-limited onboarding credit?

Carlos will be the procurement lead — looping him in for commercial coordination.

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Park
Head of Product | OmniFlow AI
elena@omniflow.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@omniflow.ai>, Carlos Ruiz <carlos@omniflow.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation playbook & volume ladder — plan and timeline

Elena / Carlos — appreciate the detail. I attached a short commercial term sheet and an updated MAP that reflects the adjusted ramp targets (see Commercial-Terms-OmniFlow.docx and MAP-OmniFlow-v1.pdf). Quick notes:

- Recommended onboarding credit: $25k applied to first invoice if contract signs by EOM.
- Discount ladder (list pricing assumed):
  * 0–299M/month: list (no discount)
  * 300–599M/month: 10% list discount
  * 600M+/month: 18% list discount
- We can offer a 30-day evaluation credit pool (~$8k equivalent) during the focused eval period.

We can model the ramp you proposed (200M -> 400M -> 800M) but to maintain economics I need to confirm whether OmniFlow can commit to a 12-month term at the 800M steady state, or whether you prefer a 6-month rolling cadence. The 12-month commit unlocks deeper discounts and capacity prioritization.

If you want, I can book a 30-minute pricing walk-through with Stephanie (rev ops) and Priya (sales leadership) to confirm acceptable concession space.

Attach: Commercial-Terms-OmniFlow.docx

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Principal Account Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Carlos Ruiz <carlos@omniflow.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena@omniflow.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation playbook & volume ladder — plan and timeline

Marissa — thanks. A couple of procurement items before legal:

- The onboarding credit helps. Can we get written confirmation that the credit applies even if we scale slower than projected?
- We are asking for a 15% discount at the 600M tier as a target; your proposal at 18% at 600M is actually generous but we need visibility on whether that requires a 12-month firm commit vs a 6-month rolling commit.
- Can you shorten the DocuSign turnaround? Our target is to close before the quarter-end (31 Jul) to align internal budgets.

If you can confirm the contract term and discount guardrails, we’ll prioritize legal review.

Thanks — Carlos
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: OmniFlow MAP / discount ask — need approval to concede

Team — forwarding the OmniFlow thread. Highlights: customer is asking for clarity on whether 18% at 600M requires 12-month firm commit; they would be satisfied at 15% with a 6-month rolling commit if we can close by 31 Jul. They are an attractive mid-market reference for content moderation and will drive global usage if the integration goes well.

Request: Can we approve a one-time concession to 15% at 600M with the following constraints?
- Signed SOW + 6-month rolling contract (auto-renews monthly after 6 months unless canceled with 60d notice)
- Minimum 3-month ramp schedule committed in MAP (200M -> 400M -> 800M by month 6)
- Reduced onboarding credit to $15k if concession accepted

I can take this to legal for redline if you confirm.

Thanks — Logan

Priya
